data.rationale: Total Assets = Lending & Liquidity Assets + Other Assets
Lending & Liquidity Assets = Cash + Loans + Liquid Assets + Other
Deposits & Central Bank Funding = Deposits & ILTR + Accruals + Derivatives + Other
Total Equity = Share Capital & AT1 + Retained Earnings + Reserves
Liquid Assets (BoE Reserves, Gilts, T-Bills) = BoE Reserves + Gilts & T-Bills + Bank Placements
Total Liabilities & Equity = Deposits & Funding + Other Liabilities + Equity
Fixed, Intangible & Other Assets = Equipment + Accum. Depreciation + Intangibles + Other
Capital Instruments & Other Liabilities = Tier 2 + Tax + Provisions
Ending Cash = Net Change + Beginning Cash
Net Change in Cash = CFO + CFI + CFF
Cash Flow from Financing Activities = Tier 2 / Central Bank + AT1 + Coupons
Cash Flow from Investing Activities = Technology Investment + Disposals + Other

data.expression: SUM(cf-ni, cf-da, cf-dar, cf-dinv, cf-dap, cf-dwc)
data.rationale: Cash Flow from Operating Activities = PAT + D&A + Balance Sheet Movements
Impairment Charge (IFRS 9 ECL) = Stage 1/2 Movement + Stage 3 Provisions + Overlays
Depreciation & Amortisation = Equipment + Leases + Software
Operating Profit = Pre-Depreciation Profit − D&A
Operating Margin % = Operating Profit / Operating Income x 100
Pre-Depreciation Profit = GP − Operating Costs
Pre-Depreciation Margin % = Pre-Depreciation Profit / Operating Income x 100
Profit before Tax = Operating Profit + Fair Value Items
Free Cash Flow = CFO + CapEx
Income after Impairment = Operating Income − Impairment
Income after Impairment % = GP / Operating Income x 100
Profit after Tax = PBT − Tax
Net Profit Margin % = PAT / Operating Income x 100
Fair Value & Derecognition Items = FVTPL + Derecognition + Other
Operating Costs = Origination & Distribution + Technology & Data + Operations, Risk & Corporate
Total Operating Income = Interest & Fee Income − Interest & Fee Expense
